_meta.notes: Bodies are plain text with \n line breaks; the email template wraps them and renders cta_label/cta_url as a button. WhatsApp texts use WhatsApp formatting (*bold*) and must be submitted as approved WhatsApp Business templates before use; send only to families who opted in. Keep the same keys in both languages. Dates, times and amounts must be pre-formatted in the recipient's locale and time zone by the CRM. Do not add any rescheduling, refund or cancellation policy line unless the business supplies the exact wording.

placeholders.{{PARENT_FIRST_NAME}}: Recipient's first name (parent, or the adult learner).
placeholders.{{RABBI_NAME}}: Rabbi's name with title, e.g. 'Rabbi David'. (French file: 'Rav David', no article.)
placeholders.{{RABBI_BIO_SHORT}}: 2-3 sentence bio from the rabbi data (in the email's language).
placeholders.{{LESSON_DATE}}: Localized date in the family's time zone, e.g. 'Tuesday, March 4' (FR: 'mardi 4 mars').
placeholders.{{LESSON_TIME}}: Localized time in the family's time zone, e.g. '5:30 p.m.' (FR: '17 h 30').
placeholders.{{TIMEZONE}}: Human-readable time zone of the family, e.g. 'New York time' (FR: 'heure de Paris').
placeholders.{{BOOKING_URL}}: Link to book a lesson slot.
placeholders.{{LOGIN_EMAIL}}: Email address used to log in.
placeholders.{{LINK_EXPIRY_HOURS}}: Validity of the setup link, in hours.
placeholders.{{AI_ASSISTANT_URL}}: Link to the family's AI assistant.
placeholders.{{GUIDES_URL}}: Link to the guides library (in the family's language).
placeholders.{{PARASHA_GUIDE_URL}}: Link to the guide of the student's Torah portion.
placeholders.{{RECORDING_URL}}: Link to the lesson recording in the portal.
placeholders.{{LESSON_SUMMARY}}: Rabbi's summary of the lesson (bullet list, in the email's language).
placeholders.{{HOMEWORK}}: Practice tasks before the next lesson (bullet list).
placeholders.{{MILESTONE}}: Short noun phrase describing the milestone, e.g. 'Both aliyah blessings, by heart' (FR: 'Les deux bénédictions de la montée à la Torah, par cœur').
placeholders.{{LESSONS_COMPLETED}}: Number of lessons completed so far.
placeholders.{{NEXT_GOAL}}: Next goal set by the rabbi, short phrase.
placeholders.{{EVENT_DATE}}: Date of the Bar/Bat Mitzvah, localized.
placeholders.{{AMOUNT}}: Amount, formatted with currency in the email's locale ('€750' / '$850'; FR: '750 €' / '850 $').
placeholders.{{PAYMENT_METHOD}}: e.g. 'Visa ending in 4242' (FR: 'Visa se terminant par 4242').
placeholders.{{ITEM_DESCRIPTION}}: e.g. 'Complete Bar Mitzvah course' (FR: 'Parcours complet Bar Mitsva').
placeholders.{{PAYMENT_DUE_DATE}}: Date by which payment must be updated, localized.

email.preheader: Your payment is confirmed. Here's what happens next.
email.body:
Hi {{PARENT_FIRST_NAME}},

Thank you, and welcome! Your payment is confirmed, and {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}}'s {{CEREMONY}} journey with a rabbi in Israel begins today.

Here's what happens next:

1. Your parent portal: your login details arrive in a separate email within a few minutes.
2. Your rabbi: we'll introduce you to {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}}'s rabbi very soon.
3. Your first lesson: you'll pick a time that suits your family, always shown in your local time.

In the meantime, your personal AI assistant is ready to answer your questions, day or night, in English: {{AI_ASSISTANT_URL}}

We're so glad you're here.

Warmly,
The Zoom Mitzvah International team

email.subject: 30 days to go until {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}}'s {{CEREMONY}}
email.preheader: How to make the last weeks calm and confident.
email.body:
Hi {{PARENT_FIRST_NAME}},

In 30 days, it's {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}}'s {{CEREMONY}}. What a moment it's going to be.

A few ideas to make these last weeks calm and confident:

• Practice a little every day with the lesson recordings. Short and regular beats long and stressful.
• Read the speech out loud at home. Family makes a warm first audience.
• If you can, arrange a rehearsal at your synagogue so {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}} can get to know the place.
• Confirm the final details with your synagogue (what exactly will be read, who is called up, timings) and share any change with {{RABBI_NAME}}.

From now on, {{RABBI_NAME}} will focus the lessons on final preparation. The guide to {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}}'s portion is here if you'd like to read it together: {{PARASHA_GUIDE_URL}}

We're counting down with you.

Warmly,
The Zoom Mitzvah International team

email.preheader: From all of us in Israel: we're so proud.
email.body:
Hi {{PARENT_FIRST_NAME}},

Mazal tov! {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}} has completed the course with {{RABBI_NAME}}.

Behind this moment are hours of practice, courage and patience, from {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}} and from you. Thank you for trusting us with such an important step in your family's life. From all of us in Israel, and from {{RABBI_NAME}} personally: we are so proud.

Learning doesn't have to stop here. If {{STUDENT_FIRST_NAME}} would like to keep going, with tefillin, the weekly portion or any other topic, just reply to this email and we'll talk about it.

Mazal tov again, to the whole family.

Warmly,
The Zoom Mitzvah International team
